header.title: AI Quiz Generator
header.subtitle: Transform official MoSPI learning materials, field manuals, and guidelines into grounded diagnostic MCQs using the platform's multi-stage RAG pipeline.

disclaimer.title: Decoupled Backend AI / RAG Pipeline Architecture
disclaimer.description: In this prototype environment, document ingestion, OCR layout extraction, dense vector chunking, and LLM question synthesis are performed via a decoupled backend service adapter. The web browser client does not execute local LLM inference. In production, this connects seamlessly to the MoSPI secure cloud RAG service (FastAPI/LangChain/LlamaIndex) with official SME validation.
